{{Quote|You never forget the first time you get whacked with one of those things.|Han Solo|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Stun Baton}}</ref>}}
A '''stun baton''', also known as '''shock baton''' or '''energy baton''', was a non-lethal short-range melee weapon that immobilized organic targets with a powerful [[Stun/Legends|electrical shock]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Who wouldn't want a sturdy club that releases a low-powered stun charge every time you hit someone with it?|Chentu Chek|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
A stun baton had a power pack in the handle,<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> which was used to activate the high-density cells that produced a stunning charge, making the weapon a little unwieldy.<ref name="KOTOR1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The power cells could last three hours before requiring a recharge.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It required the user to physically touch or strike the target in order to immobilize them effectively.

They were commonly utilized by police forces who preferred to incapacitate instead of kill their targets.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Some brawlers would use them in melee combat to increase their attack power.

More advanced versions of these weapons included the [[Bothan stun stick]], the [[Chuka]], the [[Vulkar shock stick]], the [[Rakatan Battle Wand]],<ref name="KOTOR1" /> the [[Gand silencer]], the [[Gand discharger]] and the [[Exchange negotiator]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==History==
It was dated to be used back during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR1" />

The stun baton was used by [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] as well as [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]], who used it as a crowd-control weapon. The [[501-Z police droid]] was likewise typically equipped with a stun baton.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> It was also used by guards or security officers such the the [[Corellian Security Force]],<ref name="TOR:CE">{{TORcite|type=item|CorSec Electrobaton|the Cartel Market}}</ref> the [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]],<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> as well as security forces that worked for trade organizations such as the [[Metatheran Cartel]]<ref name="ARv">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: Revelation and Refutation}}</ref> or even criminal organizations. In contrast, slaver organizations such as the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]] used stun batons to a more lethal effect.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

The stun baton was also used as a backup melee weapon by [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Trooper]]s.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

It is rumored that during the Galactic Civil War, there existed material to build stun batons with incredible power in a [[Geonosian Bio-Lab]], supposedly hidden on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
